newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPs set sights on 137.40.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPs set sights on 137.40.

text.p: September BTPs could aim for 137.40 on Wednesday, but with technical indicators suggesting the rally is overdone, investors should be wary of a correction to at least 135.55, technical analysts said.
"For today, 137.40,60 is a reasonable target," said Daniele Castelnuovo, analyst at Banca Euromobiliare in Milan.
"The only risk is an unforseeable fall of the U.S. T-bond which could impair general uptrend of European markets."
By 0800 GMT, September BTPs were up 43 basis points at 136.69, off an earlier record high at 136.72.
Louise Jones, fixed income analyst at Technical Data in London, was more cautious on the contract, pointing to daily studies which confirm the rally is overdone.
Charts show the 14-day Relative Strength Index at 79.8 percent, above the 70 percent overbought level.
"But the market seems reluctant to embark on anything too ambitious on the downside," said Jones. She put trendline resistance at 137.00, followed by the psychological 137.50.
On the downside, she said the 136.00 area should hold, but below there put support at 135.55, an area of heavy intraday trade on July 4.
A bigger correction could take the market down to 133.60, she added. That level is the 38.2 percent retracement of the move from 129.07 on June 10 to Tuesday's high at 136.40.
By 0814 GMT, September eurolira was unchanged at 93.44.
